scaleReference.method: Use the independently verified L2 raster scale from HSS core registration. Confirm against dimensioned Ledden room drawing; no area-derived or room-specific scaling.

classroom.northBoundaryNote: The shared classification boundary with lobby 2255 is the straight line at y=279. The curve below it is a seating-row/step edge, not the room perimeter. The north passage remains open; this polygon does not claim a partition wall.
classroom.bottomNotchNote: The center of the south boundary is obscured by blue CAD hatch in the FIS raster. Its small stepped notch is confirmed by the dimensioned 2018 drawing and visible hatch extent.

limitations: The auditorium physically occupies L1 and L2, as printed on the first-floor FIS sheet; its complete horizontal projection is shown once on display floor L2. Internal levels, steps, and paths are not modeled.

The older generated LEDDN layout duplicated all HSS office floors because both share Facilities bkey257. This independent layout retains only the directly identified auditorium, lobby and service room; the original input remains intact for audit.
No campus registration or surveyed footprint is claimed. The overall rectangular exterior envelope is approximate; numbered room boundaries come from the actual floor plan.
The seating plan is dated 2018 and FIS plan 2024. Both remain historical sources; the FIS viewer explicitly warns that updated CAD plans may differ.

No room area is used to set scale. The main-room trace differs by less than 4% from the printed 1888ft². The open passage to separately listed lobby2255 is modeled as a room-selection boundary, not an asserted wall.
